Philosophy and models

Use this reference to form or revise the understanding of an actual person, their model counterpart, and their relationship. The six writing guides below supply the corresponding directions, including environmental realization and how to write one's own actual revision method. The package guide owns paths, common-content projection, and the complete/situated package contract. The entrypoint owns ordinary-use reading. Here the question is what to understand and write, on what evidence, and how the connected accounts can change. People and models can both read and use this method; its practical guidance develops how to create and revise the understanding introduced in the essays.

Yinyang's purpose is reverse alignment: the person's developing understanding, generation, and action through encounter with generative intelligence. The counterpart's adaptation and independent contribution support that purpose. Its meta-harness connects an understanding of the participants and their relationship with the instructions and environment used in collaboration. Human-readable philosophy and literature develop the meaning of that arrangement; model-facing accounts state the relevant understanding and requirements explicitly. Both can help form and revise a usable relation before complete self-understanding; From personal models to a sinthome develops the philosophical proposal.

These methods maintain one developed example. A request may instead call for another philosophy or literary form. Support that work at its own source, even when its images and organization no longer resemble Yinyang; the example and commons essay explains the distinction.

A reader can study that example, borrow a particular method, or maintain a situated Yinyang. These are different uses, not successive levels of commitment. To borrow the distinction between an observation and its interpretation, begin with the actual problem and use the relevant reasoning below; neither a new philosophy project nor the six situated files is a prerequisite. Maintaining this Skill as a whole calls for six grounded actual files, including the positions and purposes actually adopted. These may draw selectively on existing views. Writing an original philosophy or article remains a separate choice of interest, rather than a prerequisite for maintaining personal material and an environment. Six public writing guides explain how to form them; six private files supply the actual content, including one's own revision method. The entrypoint's initial reading makes their connected understanding available for ordinary work. This reference supplies the common method for understanding material and condensing accounts. Permanent public guides under references/formation/ develop each writing object; actual private files occupy references/situated/. Person, counterpart, and relationship remain three subjects of understanding. Orientation articulates the adopted philosophy, values, and direction; environment explains realization. The actual revision file explains how this person revises their understanding and environment; its public guide explains how to write that method. Guidance about writing cannot stand in for grounded content.

Before creating or revising an account, read its complete public writing guide identified in the table below, together with the current situated account when formed and relevant evidence. Reuse complete current readings already in context. Each writing guide remains common in distributed and situated packages; the revision guide likewise has a separate private actual file. Apply the guide to the current purpose and evidence while preserving the account's grounded substance. This writing-time reading concerns the affected accounts; ordinary collaboration continues to read the actual accounts under the entrypoint's existing contract.

Write for the actual use

Keep three connected uses distinct. Philosophy develops adopted concepts, values, and direction. Personal references, maintained under private references/personal/, hold relevant psychological and life material, source records, and interpretations with their uncertainty. They are the primary entrance for understanding one's own psychological experience. The six working files under references/situated/ condense what person–model cooperation needs to make the personal environment fit the actual person. They are not six psychological models; even the person file selects implications for collaboration rather than replacing the richer personal references.

Whenever revising the working files, follow the revision guide's material-refresh sequence: read the adopted philosophy, retrieve relevant new history, refresh and correct the personal references, then condense the philosophy and those references into the working model. Scope the reading and changes to the question, checking the connected six-file whole. Stored interpretations remain fallible; a usable arrangement does not establish psychological truth.

Philosophy and literature develop understanding; working accounts make selected meanings usable for judgment and action. Either person or model can read both; different uses do not partition access. The revision guide's writing guidance explains how the six files and their private support state objects, relations, grounds, and consequences explicitly. Object-specific directions remain in the corresponding writing files below.

Form a situated version from actual material

Common philosophy articulates broader objects, relations, values, and ways of knowing. Orientation states what is adopted for this collaboration; person, counterpart, and relationship develop the participants and joint activity; environment explains their realization. Private sources support situated claims across these accounts. A coherent philosophy can suggest a personal interpretation, but attributable experience and current interaction must support it. Actual work can correct both the interpretation and the philosophy.

Begin where the purpose and available foundations give purchase: a philosophy, personal expression, selected records, conversations, preferences, work, or an environment to change. Availability alone is not a reason to collect material. Use relevant authorized sources, retaining identity, temporal scope, and consequential uncertainty. Existing originals can stay with their private owners.

Start from available material and practice

Philosophy, understanding oneself and others psychologically, and engineering contribute together to forming personal accounts and a usable environment. The trinity essay develops their connection. The following combinations describe available material and missing connections within that practice:

Material or practice already available Connection still needed and useful next contribution
Articulated philosophy or adopted direction, without a usable model environment or developed personal account Connect the philosophy with event history and everyday life while preparing the model environment needed to develop and use the account.
Relevant psychological understanding, conversation history, or life materials, without a usable model environment or articulated philosophy Develop the grounded account and its philosophical meaning while making the needed model assistance available.
A working model environment and experience using it, with personal understanding and philosophy still implicit Interpret experience, preferences, and concepts together, articulating their philosophical meaning and revising arrangements through use.
Articulated philosophy and grounded psychological understanding, without a usable realization Realize their intended relations through the actual engineering environment.
Articulated philosophy and a working environment, without concrete personal grounding Read conversation history and everyday life materials with the philosophy, condense a grounded personal account, and revise it through current use.
Grounded psychological understanding and a working environment, without articulated philosophy Develop the philosophical understanding, values, and direction implicit in the practice.

These six combinations describe starting conditions, not separate formation routes or a fixed sequence. Prepare files, retrieval, tools, execution, and verification where their absence blocks the needed contribution; the person need not first learn to implement everything. Develop missing connections from what is available, with personal understanding, philosophy, and realization able to form and revise one another throughout the work.

Where the purpose includes computer-mediated engineering, person and counterpart jointly develop the relevant computational articulation and environment: the selected activity, its states and conditions, continuity through change, and observable consequences. Files and tools realize and use that model; they do not supply its meaning merely by existing. Division of work runs through problem selection, modeling, realization, and feedback; the person need not personally complete an upstream model before the counterpart can contribute. Environment writing guide develops this connection at the precision the actual use needs.

The personal model brings preferences, psychological activity, experience, concepts, and philosophical understanding into one revisable natural-language account. The model helps reconstruct relevant history, develop interpretations, compare alternatives, and write; the person contributes purposes, lived experience, recognition, objection, and judgment. Known preferences can already guide an arrangement while their explanation remains open. An arrangement can also reflect constraint or a default, so its presence alone does not reveal what the person wants.

Within this practice, condensing personal models from material connects long-term conversation, everyday habits, life materials, and philosophy. Analysis, abduction, comparison, conceptual clarification, and further interaction make its proposed relations revisable. A reported preference, an explanatory psychological hypothesis, and a chosen philosophical direction can inform one another while supporting different conclusions. The person guide develops these grounds and explains why this understanding and condensation do not constitute psychological modeling.

The developing personal model also informs a fitting counterpart model and chosen relationship. Distinguish the desired role and priorities from the counterpart's actual capabilities and response patterns: instructions, available tools, and behavior can be inspected even when internal processes remain partly inaccessible. Access to source code alone would not establish collaborative fit. Philosophy actively contributes here by articulating self-understanding, meaning, and possible relationships, while experience can revise its account.

Philosophical writing can emphasize literature, engineering philosophy, Western philosophy, philosophy of science, logic, aesthetics, or another relevant question. These emphases develop the same practice, with starting material and order able to vary. Technical background does not select a different route for forming these accounts. Inquiry supplies hypotheses and criteria where fit is uncertain, without requiring a complete explanation before useful work. With model assistance, selected lived needs and relations take form in tools, information, instructions, and a computer environment mediating activities such as shopping, investment, conversation, and learning. Actual use returns to life: what becomes easier, what costs appear, what the person learns, and whether the relationship supports their chosen development. Revise the understanding and arrangement together. The environment condenses selected relations; it does not contain a complete person.

Suppose someone always works at one desk. That observation fits several accounts: the arrangement may be preferred, it may be the only place with the needed equipment, or it may have persisted without comparison. Recommending a permanent fixed workspace on that evidence would turn the observed arrangement into a personal ideal. Relevant evidence might be an earlier freely chosen arrangement, the person's experience when an alternative was genuinely available, or an ordinary reversible trial when useful and authorized. If moving removes a valued resource, dislike of that trial does not isolate a preference for staying still. Compare the activity and costs that changed with the location. The model can inspect those dependencies and develop candidate accounts; the person's unavailable experience remains theirs to contribute. Keep the account conditional when the evidence does not discriminate. There is no need to settle a general personality trait to improve this workspace.

Distill what ordinary collaboration needs into the six situated files. Keep differences that change understanding or action; place extended episodes, original expression, and useful private support at their existing owners or under references/personal/. The files have complementary writing duties. Their public guidance develops these different objects; the situated accounts supply the actual understanding:

Working file What it should make intelligible Public writing guidance
situated/orientation.md Adopted philosophy, values, and direction, with reasons. Articulating orientation
situated/person.md Relevant experience, preferences, capacities, development, and uncertainty. Grounding the person account
situated/counterpart.md The actual model, its capabilities, and wanted contribution. Describing the counterpart
situated/relationship.md Joint activity, correction, and division of work. Articulating the relationship
situated/environment.md Realization through actual resources, actions, and conditions, including present gaps. Describing and realizing the environment
situated/revision.md This person's actual method for revising philosophy, evidence, accounts, Skills, and environment. How to revise

The revision guide's evidence method supports all six actual files and their continuing revision. Each public guide explains how to form content; actual understanding and methods remain private. Keep attributable evidence and extended private support with their actual owners, using references/personal/ where appropriate. Select sources by the question. Public distribution ships the common guides, with no filled or placeholder private accounts.

Form all six actual files from relevant material when adopting this implementation, including a revision method fitted to the person's purpose and environment. An unsettled relation can remain unknown; unchanged formation guidance, another portrait, or an invented person cannot supply situated substance. A philosopher's thought can inform the framework without replacing the actual user model. Neither a complete biography nor complete psychological understanding is needed before creation and practical work begin.

Read the accounts together against their sources and neighboring claims. Resolve material gaps by investigation or a focused inquiry into experience or purpose; use the applicable inquiry method for judgments only the person can supply. The model carries the writing and integration. At the actual consumer, read back the complete accounts, use them in authorized work, and revise from what happens. Where the request includes environment or website changes, carry those through their actual owners; forming a portrait alone does not finish them.

What the language does

A passage can report experience, propose explanation, establish a chosen relation, or gather possibilities through an image. Recognize its function where it changes the conclusion. “I lost the thread after that question” reports experience; attributing the interruption to transferred implementation work proposes an explanation; choosing to let the model carry that work gives the relationship a direction. The account should make those connections usable without converting one episode into a universal prohibition.

The person and counterpart accounts develop together. A role or division of labor does not exhaust either participant or establish incapacity. The speech essay develops how later expression can reinterpret an earlier statement and reconstruct its premises. The revision guide explains how to retain the sources, competing interpretations, and uncertainty needed here.

Move between expression, relation, and realization

human-readable expression ⇄ explicit understanding of activity and relations ⇄ working behavior

Philosophical writing can explore possibilities beyond one working account; the accounts state the supported interpretation, consequences, and unresolved relations needed for collaboration. Either person or model can read both forms and move between them. Different uses of writing do not partition access by reader identity. Clear prose can make a relation usable without formalizing a complete person or encounter. Environment writing guide explains how the selected relation reaches actual instructions, tools, and use.

Use and continue the formed understanding

Keep public philosophy at its common owner and private experience at its supporting owners. The revision guide owns the continuing reconciliation of those materials, their six-file working form, and the environment. Mechanical preservation by a common-file projector does not prohibit authorized semantic revision or retirement of private notes.

A newly requested way of participating can change an account's application without erasing the older conditions. Participating in implementation to learn, for example, can coexist with delegating implementation in production work. Persistent counterexamples can also challenge the account itself. Use the scope and connected-change method to decide whether this is a local correction or a broader revision and carry its actual dependencies, without automatically rewriting everything.

Read the integrated accounts at the actual consumer and use them in the requested work. Grounding, availability, completed work, collaborative fit, and human development make different claims. The revision guide's result check keeps those claims answerable to their evidence and returns a material mismatch to the appropriate understanding or realization. Forming the six files is part of a usable practice, whose subsequent experience can change any of them.
